headline: Trench Takeoff: structures are placed from the names printed on the plan sheets pinned into the drawing, and a structure inside the traced rock boundary is priced under the open cut. Two jobs the tool had never seen were run blind: 114 of 124 rows right on one, none wrong and green. QA Scrub: large civil sets upload as normal, Dismiss works, the map loads, findings name their layer, and the rock rule is the refusal count.
